name: Databuddy
long_description:
Databuddy gives you your very own data analyst, always watching over your data, combining all your context to investigate and paint a full picture on every product issue that emerges in real-time; conversion drops, user frustration and churn.

It makes your product better without needing to have you look at a dashboard and spend hours figuring out the why. one click to install or switch from any dated analytics provider.
one_liner: AI Data Analyst for fast-growing teams
